purpose: Test one generic columnar Claim renderer after the frozen cost ledger showed that Claim statement plus conditions/provenance dominate agent-visible payload cost while evidence interval merging was ineligible.
interpretation: Post-hoc Dev/Regression mechanism evidence only. A pass authorizes this renderer as a frozen G3-C candidate, not production rollout or answer-quality claims.

algorithm: Keep candidate rank and candidate order unchanged.
Emit the fixed column names once and one positional row per Claim.
Represent every legacy Claim communication and semantic field exactly once; claimId must no longer be duplicated between two object arrays.
Sort retrieval aliases, conditions and knowledge references exactly as the frozen baseline projection does.
Do not dictionary-encode values, abbreviate field values, remove nulls, summarize text or use domain-specific rules in v1.
Decode every structured row back into the two frozen baseline projections and require byte-identical stable hashes.
Keep source metadata and RAW evidence interval rendering byte-identical to the frozen baseline; do not combine this test with interval merging.

decisionRules.GO_G3C: All 100 rows pass every identity and semantic reconstruction guard, no row grows, deterministic hashes match and combined estimated-token reduction is at least 5%.
decisionRules.NARROW_G3C: All zero-loss guards pass but combined reduction is below 5% or any row grows. Preserve the result; do not try a second renderer on these revealed questions.
decisionRules.REWORK: Any hash mismatch, missing field, identity drift, source/evidence payload change, nondeterminism, Gold/retrieval/Relation/production ContextPack/model/network/canonical-state use, overwrite or threshold change.

reasonixBoundary.reason: Reasonix doctor reports the entire WikiMemory repository as a write root and enabled networked plugins. --dir changes the project root but does not prove path-level read isolation from Stage B/Gold.
reasonixBoundary.permittedUse: After Codex implements and freezes the candidate, Reasonix may review a pasted, self-contained pure-function diff with tools disabled; it may not explore this repository or execute benchmark commands.

stopRules: This is the single optimization implementation permitted after the cost baseline.
At most one new run plus one implementation-defect repair; no threshold or schema tuning after results.
Do not expose Gold, Stage B, answer reports or case-level quality metrics to the renderer or Reasonix.
Preserve the first renderer report and completion proof.
